concept.prompt: Product photograph of a single huge ancient iron war cleaver shaped like an oversized kukri: a single-edged blade narrow at the grip swelling forward into a very fat wide belly near the tip, curving forward like a fat sickle, the sharp edge on the inside of the curve, a thick blunt spine outside, a hooked point; dark pitted oiled iron; short one-handed dark wood grip with iron ferrule, rivets and butt cap; uniform light grey background
concept.note: three seeds of a falx prompt gave a gladius, a bill and a spear; three of the kukri prompt gave this at seed 7 (drawn grip-up: rotated 180°), a leaf blade and a spear head. The first attempt (an axe on a split background) is not the source.
